title: The big pushforward restricts to the small one, and the comparison is stable under base change
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma compares the big and small pushforwards for a morphism of schemes, in six forms covering abelian sheaves, modules, restriction to the small site of a base, and base change of the comparison (statement lines 21195-21233). The proof (proof lines 21235-21267) uses K-injective representatives and the injectivity comparison for the abelian statements, quotes the two localisation statements for cartesian squares, and obtains the module statements through the composition lemma for ringed pushforwards together with exactness of the restrictions. H2: a collection of short reductions, each written out.
